newsitem.title: ESTONIA: BOURSE CLOSE - INDEX 1.30 PERCENT LOWER.
newsitem.headline: BOURSE CLOSE - INDEX 1.30 PERCENT LOWER.

text.p: * Preliminary closing data from the Tallinn stock exchange
put total trade on the Estonian bourse at 37.6 million kroons
* The Talse online index lost 1.30 percent to close at
263.62. (See index on stock exchange web site:
* Preliminary data showed that Forekspank was the
most active stock with turnover of 12.3 million kroons to close
* Hansapank's closing price 2.30 kroons lower from
Monday close 138.70 kroons on 11.3 million kroons.
